title: AI Readiness Knowledge Base — Document Manifest Record
description: One row of manifest.csv. Describes a single publicly available national policy/regulatory document contributed to the ITU AI Readiness knowledge base.

doc_id.description: Stable identifier. Format: {COUNTRY}-{BODY}-{SHORTNAME}-{YEAR}. Never reuse or renumber; downstream chunk IDs depend on it.

tier.description: core = ingested and analysed; referenced = cited in the report with a verified URL, not retrieved or indexed; method = methodological reference.

title_en.description: Official English title as printed on the document. Do not paraphrase.

title_ar.description: Official Arabic title, if the document has one.

issuing_body.description: Publishing authority, e.g. SDAIA, SAMA, NCA, NDMO, CST, DGA, NIST.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3. Use INT for international/non-national reference documents.

status.description: Legal force. CRITICAL: gap analysis is meaningless if binding and advisory instruments are conflated. 'unknown' is permitted but must be resolved before submission.

year.description: Year of the specific version held, not of first issuance.

url.description: Direct URL to the document as published by the issuing body. Prefer the authority's own domain over any aggregator or mirror.

url_accessed.description: ISO date the URL was last successfully fetched. Written by fetch.py.

http_status.description: HTTP status of last fetch attempt. Written by fetch.py.

format.description: Detected on fetch; for manually retrieved copies, the format of the held file rather than the URL response (see notes).

is_official_translation.description: True when an English copy is a translation of an Arabic authoritative original. In Saudi law the Arabic text governs; record this so the limitation can be stated honestly.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the fetched bytes. Written by fetch.py. Changes flag upstream revision — see `verify`.

page_count.description: PDF page count, or 0 for HTML.

itu_factors.description: ITU AI Readiness factors this document evidences.

itu_dimensions.description: ITU AI Readiness dimensions (1-13) this document evidences.

reference_pair.description: If this national document is analysed against an international reference, the doc_id of that reference. Drives the gap-detection engine.

license_note.description: Redistribution terms. Default assumption: publicly readable does NOT mean redistributable. Raw copies stay local unless this says otherwise.

local_path.description: Path under kb/raw/. Written by fetch.py. Gitignored by default.
